notes.title: Exiori v1.4 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/5e5fbcf2bf17ffbb85e63b4a9fc5b53af63df0ba.png
Hello and welcome to Exiori's Final Update. It's been a long road with tons of effort and lots of hardship, but the end is finally here. Even though the game has been finished for awhile, the promises are now mostly kept.

Please keep in mind that if the sides of the window are black, please consider selecting Fullscreen in the options.

Without anymore wait, here is what is new:

-Added in the rest of Female Krosuji's NFSW content. You can access it in the Yukino Kingdom.

-You can now unlock the Developer Room (Gallery) for Female Krosuji and unlock the threesome scene. (The Gallery has been in the game for Male Krosuji for a very long time now).

-Changed the Developer Room (Gallery)'s music.
(Maria is playable in the room).

-Maria Kojiryu is now briefly playable in the main story.

-Fixed some grammar.

-Updated a ton of the old plugins, including the save core one. (Hopefully this fixes the issue some people were having).



-Updated the U.I. in Soneraka Online. Fixed some bugs.

-Added in Maria Kojiryu (Solenars Edge Rebirth) to Soneraka Online as
a playable character.

-Changed the title screen music for Soneraka Online.

-Took out some shortcuts.

-Increased the level cap from level 60 to 70.



Please note: For those of you who are experiencing crashes due to your anti-virus marking the game as a false positive and quarantining the game's files.

Please consider white-listing or changing your anti-virus. I can 100 percent say with absolute certainty that I do NOT know how to produce a virus nor would I ever want to.

It would make no sense what-so-ever to ruin all the hard work and money that has been put into this game for that. I know this issue doesn't affect most people and there are some who have fixed it on their end.

Hopefully this update has made it easier for you to play again, otherwise please change your anti-virus. I highly suggest using Avira.

Lastly, I hope this work will be appreciated by all for what it's worth.
If you enjoyed this game, please consider leaving a review. You may not think it matters and that you shouldn't leave one. But, trust me, it means way more than you think. Especially if you can unlock Steam emotes/cards from it.

Please consider playing other Team Syukino games if you enjoyed Exiori. Have a nice day and an even more wonderful life! Thanks for having faith that this game would be completed and promises kept from the Kick-starter onward. -Syukino

*Final note: This game wasn't allowed to be on Nutaku due to certain 3rd party appearances. That's why there won't be a Nutaku release.

notes.title: Information Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/258f7e0f5fe864ac6c7d3abf3732c6018de631fb.png
Hello, this is just a quick update to let people know what's been happening.


It's important to note that the remaining NSFW content will take time as different artists work at different paces and need to be paid. Also, I spoke to Steam support and it's important to know that I was not allowed to take out the NSFW and repackage the game with Euclyca in another Steam APP ID. So, unfortunately the Noun series edition will not be coming out.

That being said, you can still buy the games on Itch.io if it's not available in your country. The game's NSFW has something for everyone and if you don't want to access it, then just select "no". If you want a SFW playthrough, just select "no" on everything. You can play the game as is without NSFW content being shoved in your face. Save for a few specially named Items. It's all 100 percent optional. In other news...

Mina from Euclyca is coming to Falnarion Tactics III in what will hopefully be it's final update. Please look forward to that in the future!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2683250/Falnarion_Tactics_III/

Also, look forward to the final update of Exiori, coming sometime this year! Please share this game around for faster progress and to introduce people to it if they haven't played it.

notes.title: Exiori v1.2 Update Out Now! (Female Krosuji)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/910428b2a713946848d1f87d327de15efc7aae31.png

Hello and welcome to this Exiori Update!

Here is what is new:

-You can now play the entire game as Female Krosuji. (Please keep in mind that not all of her NSFW content is out and can be accessed in the future when available).

-You can now fight the Squirrel King in the Hood.

-Anima Cards have returned from Euclyca and are accessible from Chapter One onwards!

-Fixed some Grammar.

-Made it so you can actually go into the Tilnern Tombstone area as there
was no way to get there before and it was overlooked. You can get there from inside the Tilnern Graveyard to the North-East.

-Added in Female Krosuji into Soneraka Online.

*Please note that Female Krosuji NSFW content is costly and requires more time and that Elruna Episode 2 is in progress as well. Thank you for your patience. If you like Exiori, please spread it around and share it so that others can experience it!

#FemaleKrosujiWasAMistake

notes.title: Exiori v0.9 Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/ef06574eb99b3b4fdf3436568f31dbd4035c1bc1.png
Exiori v0.9 Update!

This is a brief update to the game that will bring it closer to
it's release goal.

Here is what is new;

-Added in Super Casual Mode.
You start out as max level and everything is super easy and
posses virtually no challenge. This is for the true filthy casuals.
If you select this mode, you will be judged, but your life, your choice.
You can select this mode at the start of a new game from the drop down menu.

-All new icons for the U.I.

-Max level is now level 99. Happy grinding!

-Added in a new special side-boss!

-Changed the title screen.

-Some grammar fixes.

-Fixed some animations and their descriptions.

-Fixed some music where it played incorrectly at certain times.

-Changed some bosses' face pictures in battle.

-Fixed a scene in chapter 5 that briefly showed and now it is shown longer.

-Fixed the fade out early issue in Pastel's part in chapter 5.

notes.title: Exiori X-Mas Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/a34e5312aa70e2e675908ed3d344382541cf8d5e.png

Exiori X-mas Update!
Here is what is new;
(Happy Holidays!)


-New side boss, inside of the Chimera Arena.

-Added in another arena; The Chimera Arena.
You can fight through this to unlock a special weapon for Pastel.
As well as the best-in-slot headpiece of the game.
The final boss of the arena is also X-mas themed.

-Added in a NSFW scene with Temi that you can find by interacting
with the NPC; Dorma, in the Yorusami Mansion.

*You must beat chapter 6 in order to access the above content*.



-There is an issue that very few have come across that when leaving the Lylolen Ruins, the boat disapears, leaving you stranded at the dock. This issue has now been resolved for those who have dealt with it.

-Fixed the Vial of Honor to only be able to be used on a dead
target as intended.

-Added in Abandoned Arena. A side area to explore.



Elruna and Meeth's sprites are finished!

Again, happy holidays to you and yours!

A very special thank you to those who have stuck around
through everything. You guys are the real heroes!

notes.title: Exiori Halloween Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/b347a338b5402684d7e52b529309e541cec4327a.png

This is an Halloween and quick fix update for Exiori.

Happy Halloween to you and yours! I hope you get lots of
candy and have fun dressing up. If you don't do any of that
stuff anymore, then that is fine too! Without further a boo *get it?* Here is what is new:

-Added in Cultist's Retreat (Can be accessed via airship).

-Added in an area between the Frostlands and the area to
the south called Ferdorma Trail.

-Added in a shopkeeper in Mizuho who only sells
Vials of Honor. Vials of Honor are needed for the
Seppukku skill to fully be utilized.

-Changed the unmade town of Tilnern into Tilnern Graveyard.
Which is now unlocked and can be visited on the map from
chapter 3.

-Fixed some dialogue that would cut off during a scene
in Alcornagia.

-Fixed some of the broken LBs of several characters where
it would charge MP instead of 100 TP.

-Fixed a problem where you couldn't go on ahead past a
certain point.

-Fixed some levels that would allow you to walk into places
that you shouldn't be able to.

-Fixed Mizuho's snow issue or lack there of, when entering
the town.

-Closed off the areas in the level where you play as Alfura.

-Fixed some grammar.
